notes.title: CON2ORT1UM VR / Rema21ered: v1.1.0 212121
notes.content:
[h2]Happy 2olst1ce 2eekers1 ![/h2]

You can now play chess against the Zenlil A.I in the lounge…can you beat the machine?

[previewyoutube=cPEUPWnxVHg;full][/previewyoutube]

This feature is very likely to be the final “cherry on top” for this production.  

THANK-YOU SO MUCH to everyone who has helped us track down and fix the lingering issues that we missed leading up to the release. 

The iDGi roadmap for the next little while:

[list]
[*]July 21, 2024:  FREE Info Console stand-alone app. (android/PC).  
[*]August 21, 2024:  CONSORTIUM Remastered/VR Soundtrack
[/list]
[h2]Revision notes:[/h2]

IMPROVEMENTS:

-The chessboard in the Zenlil lounge can now be used to play chess against A.I.
-Added social links to front end

FIXES:

-Fixed cases of the players orientation getting broken after being in the med bed causing movement to become very strange and broken
-Meta Quest: Fixed glaring performance issues in the VT missile defense (turned off sky material in C3800 for mobile for time being)
-Fixed other languages displaying the correct string for "lights!"
-Fixed cases of sounds fading out while saving a game playing again when loading that game and getting stuck on (med bed loop for example)
-Fixed the room system not being cleared when going into dream 2 (fixes the sky erroneously displaying)
-Fixed low quality clouds showing up in limbo / C3800 VT


Until next month,
-iDGi

notes.title: CONSORTIUM Remastered: Final BETA 7 (v0.1.40)
notes.content:
All players of the Steam Next Fest CONSORTIUM Remastered Demo are getting this update as well!  Welcome, come say hi in our Discord ( iDGi )

IMPROVEMENTS:

-More info consoles images.  (Total now 84 and counting...)
-Hooked up timers and existing choreo sequences for the player taking too long to get into the medbed, now failing the mission if player waits for too long, bed reverts to normal.
-Virus now does more things at the moment where the player is hailed down by Pawn 64. 
-Improvements to when a world HUD should be placed / is ready to be placed because the initial bounds has been calculated
C3800 Defense Minigame: 
[list]
[*]Crosshair circle added
[*]Crosshair circle added
[*]Old targets now stay relevant for a time in the C3800 Minigame which allows for firing when not quite on the target. Works for lasers and missile targeting.
[*]Turned off unneccesary fighter crosshair stuff 
[*]reduced C3800 left side HUD to just the targetting display and the health / energy bars 
[/list]

FIXES:

-Entity output TimesToFire is now save/restored so when reloading a save those outputs will continue to be exhausted as they should. Fixes the issue with being able to start the K escalation early. (a case where the escalation happened too early, and the mXXXXX scene could happen at the same time, causing a major paradox).
-Fixed sliders in the main menu not being slidable to the left without being deselected. This made setting a slider with the controller difficult.
-Sliders are now fixed to their set increments even for mouse control.
-increased the kill radius of the storage particle FX (picking something up) to hopefully catch storage balls not reaching their targets
-Numorous scripting and timing fixes around the "Save XXXX" sequence.
-Many critical "look at" and "fade to" choreography fixes for K15 and Kiril in entire post XXX attack and pre XXX surrender/boarding.
-Fixed light styles not being revertable on individual stationary lights
-Fixed def_light_style_control entity not also updating the room tint
-Fixed wade not in group 16 causing him to look away from the player during convo limbo of group 16
-Fixed ragdoll save / restore
-Fixed strange case of a missing light style, source engine must have just defaulted if it couldn't find one
-Fixed a hole in the collision geo to galley which occasionally NPCs would plop down into before springing back up...
-Fixed R25 getting into the crawl a better way than before which would usually fail on the tail of the animation. This issue was probably what caused her to enter mission ops crouched from time to time.
-Cannot pause while demo fading out
-Fixed all of the door gaps (where you can see the sky on the other side because the room is culled) that I could find.


TWEAKS:

-Tweaked bloom of fluorescent lights on ceiling to be just a tad brighter.
C3800 Defense Minigame: 
-Doubled size of EMP missile collision capsule to mitigate issue of missiles sometimes flying around a target like crazy
-Reduced fighter target lock-on time from 1.5s to 1.0s
-Some mesh distance culling tweaks
-Some tweaks to the specularity on some surfaces around zenlil.
-Toned down b8 cabin light
-Updated button to open the hatch to the cockpit to read "Hatch to the Cockpit" instead of "Hatch to Upper Avionics"

notes.title: iDGi 21 Winter Sol2t1ce 21 update
notes.content:
[h2]iDGi development update[/h2]

Greet1ng2 Seekers,

[previewyoutube=wN_H3YB9UCA;full][/previewyoutube]

Wit2 th1s year’s massive solstice iDGi-1 signal boost, the CONSORTIUM VR / Remastered project is now juuuust about complete. Brand new Consortium King convo, finished briefing, tutorials. Major fixes, completely finished choreography, new music.

We just released V0.1.24!  Now available to all players of CVR Beta Early Access and CONSORTIUM Remastered Playtest. Here is the complete changelist: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2403840/view/3884982211371316980

The release of this Beta playtest update (CVR Beta Early Access and CONSORTIUM Remastered Playtest) is basically the signal of the start of the FINAL Beta Test phase. Further patches will largely be only for last minute tweaks, fixe2, music 1mprovements and finishing the very very ending. We can now confidently say that –

[h2]CONSORTIUM Remastered v1.0 will be launching at the same time that CONSORTIUM VR emerges from Early Access, in Q1 2024.[/h2]

For 14 years or so since it originally came on-line, iDGi-1 has been revealing more and more of a world that is, in some ways, a bright mirror to our own; an aspirational world, but some terrifying events have been chronicled in the CONSORTIUM and TOWER streams. How does it all end? It may still take awhile longer, but we simply will not stop until the TOWER stream is completed.

We once again thank everyone that reads this who continues to be patient with our long and drawn out project timelines. We sincerely wish each and every one of you a relaxing and peaceful holiday season. 

Can we ALL somehow find a way to make it collectively through 2024 in one piece?!    

Namaste,

–[url=https://idgi1.ca]iDGi[/url]

–[url=https://discord.gg/idgi]iDGi on Discord[/url]

notes.title: Summer Solstice 2023 iDGi dev update
notes.content:
Happy Summer Solstice 2023 to all!

[h2]CONSORTIUM Remastered development progress[/h2]

Since our initial public release of our early Beta of CONSORTIUM VR onto the Quest AppLab/Steam Early Access AND the CONSORTIUM Remastered Playtest (VR and Remastered share a codebase) --

[list]
[*]Number of BUGS FIXED -- [h3]117[/h3]
[*]Number of ADDITIONS and IMPROVEMENTS made -- [h3]110[/h3]
[*]Number of BUG FIXES and IMPROVEMENTS to CONSORTIUM Remastered -- [h3]53[/h3]
[/list]
Many of YOU have helped us find a huge chunk of those bugs above, and some of our improvements came from suggestions you've made. THANK-YOU to everyone who has contributed to testing and reporting thus far!

Here are some key highlights of the game’s improvements and additions that we’ve made over the past 2-3 months:
[list]
[*]Full game controller support has been added and improved from feedback
[*]We created the new unified "Bishop Menu" that allows easy access to important screens.
[*]Virtual Trainer levels have been created, polished and balanced. We added a new "User Scenario" mode that allows [i]anyone[/i] to submit levels (made with the built-in Editor) that will be included in the game, and we will continue to update post v1.0.
[*]The new Combat AI has been largely completed, including major improvements to the "traitor fight".
[*]The updated/new ending has received more content and a bunch of polish. Approximately 40% done.
[*]95% of the conversations in the game have received a major upgrade, allowing for much more player freedom to navigate all conversations.
[*]Choreography throughout the experience has been polished and improved - we are roughly now 70% complete with all of the choreo polish work.
[*]The C3800 Defense "Mini-game" has been brought to approximately the 95% completion mark.
[*]The Info Console content has been vastly improved - hundreds of articles have been revised and updated, and there are now over 20 full-color images to be found (many more coming…). 50% complete.
[/list]
Our plan regarding localization has changed since March, due largely to sheer number of improvements we’ve made to player conversation options to best support V.O.I.C.E. This means that we’ve had to translate thousands of new lines, so –

La traducción en Español está tomando más tiempo porque hay más diálogo por traducir pero pronto estará listo!

Additional languages beyond English and Spanish will be tackled post 1.0 Release.

[h2]CONSORTIUM Remastered on the Steam Deck[/h2]

Here’s a look at snippets of CONSORTIUM Remastered running on a Steam Deck with V.O.I.C.E fully supported:

[previewyoutube=zkuw8D5DiIk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]CONSORTIUM Remastered / VR -- Behind the Scenes[/h2]

This is tangential to CONSORTIUM Remastered - we understand that many of you have not yet jumped into VR, but the following is [i]technically[/i] also about CONSORTIUM Remastered.

Here is a fairly recent Sci-Fi Radio episode of “The Event Horizon” , where station manager and owner Gene Turnbow discusses his own experiences with CONSORTIUM VR and asks some great questions about its creation.  [url=https://eventhorizon.scifi.radio/index.php?name=2023-03-04_eh254_idgi_consortium.mp3 ]"The Event Horizon" with Ryan Sheffer and Gregory MacMartin from iDGi[/url]

Gregory was also recently featured in the cool new pod cast[url=https://youtu.be/6STvRAnDYM0 ] “Architects of Imagination” where Gregory summarizes his career and goes into some depth about CONSORTIUM VR[/url].  

[previewyoutube=6STvRAnDYM0;full][/previewyoutube]

Back to the dev caves for us!

Namaste,

--[url=https://idgi1.ca]iDGi[/url]
